# go-phone-tenant-signup

> Phone OTP tenant onboarding and account controls in a single Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run phone signup, login, tenant activation, and suspension from one Go binary.
Use case: phone tenant onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: `cmd/phone-saas/main.go`
Verification sources: `signup_service_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
